description.text: A high-class pack released on 4 October 2019 that reprinted cards much used in official tournaments from products of December 2017 to May 2019, among them the TAG TEAMs Pikachu & Zekrom-GX, Reshiram & Charizard-GX and Mewtwo & Mew-GX, with Pokémon-GX, Prism Star cards and Trainers. It also added new cards, such as the TAG TEAMs Togepi & Cleffa & Igglybuff-GX and Trevenant & Dusknoir-GX, and Super Rare cards in new illustrations, such as Eevee-GX and Dedenne-GX. Each pack held eleven cards, one of them a TAG TEAM or other Pokémon-GX, and each box held at least one card of Super Rare or higher and one Super Rare basic Energy. The cards are numbered to 173, followed by full-art Super Rare cards including the basic Energy, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare TAG TEAMs, and nine unnumbered mirror holo basic Energy.
